name: GR-1
summary: GR-1 is a GPT-style transformer first pretrained on a large egocentric human video corpus to predict future frames given language, then fine-tuned on robot data to jointly predict future frames and actions. Video prediction acts as a physically grounded pretraining task, giving large gains on CALVIN's zero-shot generalization splits and on real-robot data efficiency.
innovation: Video prediction as the pretraining objective for a manipulation policy, absorbing dynamics from human video.
Joint frame-and-action prediction during fine-tuning, keeping the predictive signal alive.
matters: A clean demonstration that human video, not only robot data, carries manipulation-relevant knowledge.
limits: Video prediction is expensive and only loosely aligned with what control actually needs.
lineage: Transformer sequence modeling applied to video-then-action, anticipating world-model-based VLAs.
